3\. Paused playbook kits lose hold reasons 🐞 Bug ◔ Observability 
_owner_hold_reason reaches notifications only through _announce_hold, while defer_hold skips
holds filed during a pause and startup republishes held jobs without a reason override. When either
path handles a role-filed kit carrying a playbook, the human sees only apply <name>, not the
playbook path and ownership reason.
Agent Prompt ``` ## Issue description Playbook-bearing kits filed while the pipeline is paused, or republished as held after restart, bypass the new reason override and show only the gate's generic apply reason. ## Fix Focus Areas - src/hands/playbook.py[2087-2100] - src/hands/playbook.py[2134-2136] - src/hands/daemon.py[407-436] - src/hands/daemon.py[861-879] ## Recommended Fix Derive and publish the playbook-specific reason for qualifying architect-filed holds on immediate and startup publication paths as well as deferred publication. Preserve the gate's stored reason and add tests for a kit filed during a pause and one republished after restart. ``` ⓘ Copy this prompt and use it to remediate the issue with your preferred AI generation tools
